title: Omid Farda Scholarship

provider.name: University of Bremen and HERE AHEAD Academy

summary: Scholarship for Afghan students unable to begin or complete their studies due to the situation in Afghanistan, enabling preparatory and degree studies in Bremen.

degree_levels.notes: Aimed at bachelor's and master's students, including preparatory study programs at the HERE AHEAD Academy.

subject_areas.notes: Students choose a subject from the range of subjects offered by the universities in the state of Bremen.

values: universities in the state of Bremen
institutions.notes: Applies to universities in the state of Bremen, including the University of Bremen and HERE AHEAD Academy.

residence.notes: Aimed at students in life-threatening situations abroad to come and study in Bremen.

mandatory.text: Last degree no older than five years
Proof of previous school or study achievements
Explanation of the current risk situation
Unable to begin or complete bachelor's or master's studies after the Taliban took power in Afghanistan
C1 level of German required to continue with a bachelor's degree
Scholarship must be repaid in full in the event of early de-registration

funding.description: The scholarship includes the amount of a blocked account required for international prospective students (twelve times the BAföG loan maximum rate of 861 euros) and a travel allowance.

application_rounds.notes: The application period is from May 05 to June 05, 2022.

required_documents.text: Proof of previous school or study achievements
Explanation of the current risk situation

steps.text: Submit applications via the Academy's website

sources.title: NO LONGER AVAILABLE: Ten Scholarships Offered for Afghan Students - Universität Bremen
sources.notes: International Afghan students receive funding for physical study and preparatory programs in Germany.
